name: Unreal Gold
description: Unreal Gold is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game, bundling Unreal, the first game in the Unreal series, with its Return to Na Pali expansion.

steam.store_details: Delisted in December 2022, when Epic pulled the entire classic Unreal series from sale.
steam.patches: OldUnreal's v227 patch adds a modern 'ALAudio' sound renderer, a strong alternative worth trying. It replaces the game's original EAX sound, so use one or the other.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Unreal only plays EAX reverb when its hardware 3D sound, reverb and spatial sound options are all on.

optional_settings.title: Raise sound quality
optional_settings.reason: Unreal Gold mixes its sound at a low sample rate, which dulls high-pitched sounds.

optional_settings.title: Raise texture filtering
optional_settings.reason: Unreal Gold filters textures at a low level, so a visible line shows where each floor and wall texture switches to a blurrier version.

optional_settings.title: Raise color depth
optional_settings.reason: Unreal Gold runs fullscreen with a reduced color range, so smooth shading like skies and shadows shows visible bands.

optional_settings.title: Enable WASD controls
optional_settings.reason: Unreal Gold moves with the arrow keys out of the box, and its right mouse button jumps instead of using the weapon's alternate fire.
